title: Balanced product title and price typography
summary: Refine the product heading and price hierarchy with closer spacing and a more legible currency label.

changes.detail: Use a 24px semibold title (22px on compact screens), reduce the price from 34px bold to 28px semibold, increase currency to 12px, and tighten the title-to-price gap from 22px to 12px. Existing currency formatting and discount calculations remain unchanged.
